استقربن (form X)
# اِسْتَقْرَبْنَ (istaqrabna) /is.taq.rab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
# اُسْتُقْرِبْنَ (ustuqribna) /us.tuq.rib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
# اِسْتَقْرِبْنَ (istaqribna) /is.taq.rib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
